installCommand: R=$PWD; while [ ! -d "$R/apps/web" ] && [ "$R" != / ]; do R=$(dirname "$R"); done; echo "repo root: $R"; cd "$R/apps/web" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
buildCommand: O=$PWD; R=$PWD; while [ ! -d "$R/apps/web" ] && [ "$R" != / ]; do R=$(dirname "$R"); done; rm -rf "$O/_site" && mkdir -p "$O/_site" && (cd "$R/apps/web" && npx vite build --base=/app/ --outDir "$O/_site/app" --emptyOutDir) && cp -R "$R/site/." "$O/_site/"
